Name: Simon Tycho
Description: Simon Tycho was created by Supergirl (2011) writers Michael Green and Mike Johnson and portrayed by artist Mahmud A. Asrar. Simon Tycho was a Twenty-eight year old trillionaire who lives on a space station and rarely ever sets foot on Earth. When Supergirl landed to earth he captured her and held her on board his space station hoping to contract some of her Kryptonian blood. An explosion during Supergirl's escape left most of his body destroyed yet his assistant Miss Thorn was able to place him inside the body of "The Brain", an organism of basic nerves and a brain, to keep him alive.
